reason: The plugin is a Web UI resilience utility for DeepSeek Harness that focuses on client-side bootstrap stability: it hooks the module loader to skip crashing/malformed plugins, reports missing plugin bundles, and offers localStorage-based plugin blocking and reset controls, with stated no-server/no-disk-write behavior. Its primary purpose is user-facing load-time protection and operational feedback rather than plugin creation, data processing, external integrations, or collaboration.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端启动阶段的容错处理：当插件加载失败时会给出提示并支持将异常插件加入黑名单，以便界面继续加载。
summaries.en: This plugin provides client-side boot-time fault handling for DeepSeek Harness Web by notifying users of plugin load failures and allowing problematic plugins to be blacklisted so page loading can continue.

capabilities: Client-side boot-time interception of plugin factory loading with fallback behavior for malformed or throwing factories.
User-visible notices for load failures and missing bundle 404s to avoid silent startup breakage.
LocalStorage-based blocked-plugin list with revision-aware entries and clear/reset controls.
No disk writes or server/loader-route modifications by design; limited persistence is browser storage.
